footnote: Source: Ministry of Finance bond notices, local bond and Jan–Aug fiscal releases, Xinhua (September 30). Progress is the amount issued, spent or allocated as a share of the full year (calculated)
notes: Ultra-long special treasury bonds: ¥1.3 trillion for the year. Adding up the Ministry of Finance's issuance notices, ¥1.177 trillion had been issued by September 16, or 90.5%, with the last auction on October 16. New local government special bonds: ¥4.4 trillion for the year, ¥2.929 trillion issued in January to August, or 66.6%. General budget spending reached ¥18.15 trillion in January to August, 60.5% of the budget. The ¥250 billion for consumer trade-ins went out in four batches, and Xinhua reported on September 30 that the last batch had been allocated. We use that latest, clearest statement because mid-year figures from the Ministry of Finance and the planning commission did not match. The ¥300 billion of bank capital bonds had not been issued as of October 4: the first ¥150 billion is set for auction on October 8, later than the May and June dates in the original calendar. The ¥800 billion for major strategic projects was fully allocated by August 21.
